purpose: Try to falsify the center-density research direction without conflating the deterministic intersection adapter with its two open arithmetic premises.

targets.statement: A fixed Turan interval sum is negatively aligned on a positive density of eligible half-integer centers.
An upper exceptional set of size N^(1-m+o(1)) intersects a lower success set of size N^(1-rho-o(1)) when rho<m.
The retained adjacent-gap hat has the target fourth-moment decay on average over half-integer shell centers.
falsifiers: diagonal lower bound already exceeds target
center averaging preserves critical product collisions

targets.statement: For each zero-derived common witness, radialization succeeds on more than N^(1-3137/520000+o(1)) aligned centers.
falsifiers: diffuse smooth positive antenna with common source
failure-set concentration on every aligned center

passport.mask: Actual ordinary primes for theorem falsification; real pseudo-nodes only falsify soft proof classes.
passport.source: One fixed absolute prime interval I and common tau across all tested centers.
passport.normalization: N^{-1} source depth and probability-normalized upper antennas.
passport.center_set: Eligible half-integers in a length-comparable-to-N block.
passport.height_window: H_Y=[Y^.01,Y^(50/33)] with the retained-hat moment on [Y^(839/1000),2Y^(50/33)].

hard_stops: Do not call a pseudo-node construction a counterexample to an actual-prime statement.
Do not call finite adverse correlation an asymptotic refutation.
Do not call failure of one open premise a failure of the deterministic set-intersection implication.
Do not infer that an unavailable published theorem makes the conjecture false.
decision_rule: Refute the adapter only on an exact logical or normalization error. Refute an arithmetic premise only with an actual-prime asymptotic counterexample. Otherwise record the highest-fidelity proof class eliminated and update plausibility without changing theorem status.
